## 2026-11-20 — v0.67.1

### Changed

- **Windows CI runs its long Git Bash steps as parallel jobs.** `windows-security-hooks` (37-39 min of a 40 min limit) and `windows-ollama-endpoint` (up to 36 min) ran every step in sequence. Each long step now has a job of its own (`windows-scan-output`, `windows-hooks-chain`, `windows-security-gate`, `windows-hook-destinations`, `windows-hook-destinations-native`); every step that ran before still runs, unchanged.
- **`lib/ollama_endpoint.sh` trims settings and reads the models file without starting `sed`, `tr` or `tail`.** Under Git Bash each process costs tens of milliseconds and these ran once per setting or name. The results are the same; `tests/ollama_endpoint_trim_test.sh` compares them with the old commands.

### Fixed

- **Release downloads retry transient errors, and a failed one says why.** `gitleaks_install`, `foxguard_install`, `ollama_install`, the Docker key and Docker Desktop downloads, `download_file` and `dialog_download_file` tried once, so one network error failed the install (`install-publication-hooks.sh --ci` on a fresh runner). They now go through the new `lib/fetch.sh` (`fetch_to_file`): `curl --retry 3 --retry-delay 2`, plus `--retry-all-errors` on curl 7.71 or newer; `wget --tries=3 --waitretry=2`. A failure deletes the partial file and prints the host, the tool, its exit code and a reason, for example `gitleaks: download failed from github.com: curl exit 7 (could not connect)`. The checksum still runs on the file that arrives. PowerShell: `ps/lib/fetch.ps1`, 3 attempts, used by `ollama_install.ps1`, `docker_install.ps1`, `download_file` and `dialog_download_file`. wget also retries 429 and 5xx (`--retry-on-http-error`, wget 1.19.1 or newer) and runs under `timeout FETCH_MAX_TIME` when `timeout` is there; PowerShell does not retry a 4xx other than 408 and 429. Redirects keep to the URL's scheme (`curl --proto =https --proto-redir =https`; for `wget`, which applies `--https-only` only in recursive mode, `fetch_wget_follow` follows each redirect itself, to https only, at most 5), also in `download_file` and `dialog_download_file`. INT or TERM during `fetch_to_file` deletes the partial file and then runs the caller's trap. `FETCH_MAX_TIME` that is not a positive whole number means 300. The macOS and Windows Docker Desktop downloads no longer leave their temp directory behind. URLs with user info are never printed, and a query prints as `?(not shown)` with the fragment left out, so a signed URL's token stays out of logs; bash and PowerShell name the same host, with `(unknown host)` for an authority with a backslash such as `https://evil.example\@good.example/`. Tests: `tests/fetch_test.sh` and `ps/tests/fetch_test.ps1`, with shared URL cases in `tests/fixtures/fetch_url_cases.txt` (both fail without the fix). Closes https://github.com/nikolareljin/script-helpers/issues/291.
